messages:
rahul: P1 — I found a Vault token inside a CI artifact uploaded to a partner S3 bucket. Possible accidental packaging of /tmp/vault_token. Marking for immediate containment and rotation. s3 path: s3://partner-uploads/redwood/2026-03-20/build-789/artifact.tar.gz
ellie: Can you confirm whether it is a wrapped token or a raw token?
rahul: It's a base64 blob named vault_token.b64 inside the tar. header looks like a wrapped token (contains 'wrapped: true' and a kms key id). extracting minimal header to confirm now.
build-bot: scan result — high-severity secret detected in artifact.tar.gz -> https://scans.redwood.internal/scan/789 :red_circle:
sam: OK containment checklist — (1) rotate/revoke any tokens referenced in artifact, (2) revoke CI leases/roles, (3) disable the runner that produced the artifact. @sec-oncall can you lead KMS/Vault actions?
sec-oncall: taking lead. I need either the token accessor or an excerpt of the header (no raw token). rahul, paste md5 and the header lines please.
rahul: md5: 3b7a9f5d2a... path in tar: ./tmp/vault_token.b64
rahul: header excerpt: ```-----BEGIN VAULT TOKEN----- wrapped: true,kms:key-id=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-wrap```"
maria: pinging partner-ops now to take down the S3 object and prevent further downloads. I'll open a takedown ticket and DM them.
ellie: we should search audit logs for vault wrapping/unwrap ops and KMS Decrypts for that key id. Also list tokens issued by ci service account in the last 24h.
sam: useful commands: ```vault list auth/token/accessors | xargs -n1 -I{} vault token lookup -accessor {} | grep -E 'ci-runner|build-agent'``` and for KMS/GCP: ```gcloud logging read 'resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName":"Decrypt"' --freshness=1d```
sec-oncall: found an unwrap call at 2026-03-20T02:12Z by service-account:ci-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com using key ci-wrap. We're creating a new key version for ci-wrap now and will rewrap where possible. Meanwhile we should revoke any tokens that may have been unwrapped.
rahul: confirmed offending runner id: ci-runner-54. Ops, please isolate/quarantine that runner.
build-bot: deploy job aborted; ci-runner-54 moved to quarantine state by ops.
maria: partner confirmed object removed and archived offline. They've provided a short audit snippet.
sam: rotation plan (short): A) revoke tokens linked to accessor prefixes found in the artifact; B) create new KMS key-version and update Vault wrapping_key; C) rotate Vault policies that granted overly broad CI access; D) run a secrets-sleuth sweep across artifacts for last 7 days.
ellie: immediate RBAC hardening: create a least-privilege role for CI with only wrap/unwrapping capability if required (prefer wrap-only), remove token-creation/unbounded-ttl perms, enable per-request audit logging (90d retention), and add mandatory use of KMS wrap with access controls.
sec-oncall: filing incident INF-2026-345, adding timeline, artifacts, owners. Looping in legal and compliance for disclosure guidance.
rahul: I'll attach the artifact md5, audit ids, and a short replay of the steps I used to extract the header to the incident.
sam: Good. After containment we'll run a sweep job to find any other artifacts that contain vault-related headers and escalate. Keep updates here.
ellie: ack. will draft RBAC change PR and a short runbook for the CI team to adopt minimal wrapping flows.
sec-oncall: next immediate tasks assigned: rahul -> evidence & audit ids, ops -> runner quarantine, maria -> partner takedown confirmation, sam -> revoke list + rotate plan, ellie -> RBAC PR. Will update incident ticket as tasks complete. :thumbsup:
